result.instructions: Tools for Numeral, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Numeral data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run numeral_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run numeral_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run numeral_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. numeral_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: numeral_ping
tools.title: Ping (health check)
tools.description: Health check — verifies the API key works and reports the environment (test/prod), api_version, and server timestamp. Numeral: GET /tax/ping.

tools.name: numeral_calculate_tax
tools.title: Calculate tax
tools.description: Calculate sales tax / VAT for an order — a STATELESS quote that persists nothing (record it later with numeral_create_transaction using the returned calculation id). Returns per-jurisdiction rates, total_tax_amount, and totals. Provide a customer address and one or more line items (each needs reference_product_id OR product_category). Amounts are in the currency's smallest unit (cents). Numeral: POST /tax/calculations.

id.description: A Numeral customer id (cus_...) for order tracking / exemptions.

address_province.description: State/province/region — a valid 2-letter ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. "CA").

address_country.description: Country — a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "US").

address_type.description: Address type: "shipping" for physical goods, "billing" for software/digital goods.

customer_currency_code.description: Currency code. For API version 2024-09-01: "USD" or "CAD".

tax_included_in_amount.description: Do the line-item amounts already include tax? Typically false for North America.

amount.description: Line-item price in the currency's SMALLEST unit (e.g. USD 2000 = $20.00). Tax is calculated against this.

quantity.description: Quantity of this product being sold.

reference_product_id.description: Your product id (required if no product_category).

product_category.description: A tax category from Numeral's taxonomy, e.g. "GENERAL_MERCHANDISE", "SAAS_GENERAL" (required if no reference_product_id).

fallback_product_category.description: Fallback tax category used when reference_product_id has no matching product in Numeral.

reference_line_item_id.description: Your line-item id (optional; for record keeping).

line_items.description: Order line items (one per product type).

origin_address.description: The address a product ships from. Optional on 2024-09-01; required on API version 2025-05-12+.

address_province.description: State/province/region — a valid 2-letter ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. "CA").

address_country.description: Country — a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "US").

tools.name: numeral_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: Get a recorded transaction by its Numeral id (tr_...). Returns the transaction with its line items, currencies, and metadata. Numeral: GET /tax/transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: numeral_list_transaction_refunds
tools.title: List transaction refunds
tools.description: List all refunds recorded against a transaction. Returns {refunds:[...]}. Numeral: GET /tax/transactions/{transaction_id}/refunds.

tools.name: numeral_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List your Numeral products (up to 50 per page), each with its reference id, name, and product_category. Use `cursor` (the last_product_id from a previous page) to paginate; has_more indicates more pages. Numeral: GET /tax/products.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the last_product_id from the previous page.

tools.name: numeral_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product by its reference_product_id (your id). Returns the product's name, product_category, and timestamps. Numeral: GET /tax/products/{reference_product_id}.

reference_product_id.description: Your product id (the reference_product_id used when the product was created).

tools.name: numeral_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a customer by id. By default `customer_id` is the Numeral id (cus_...); set id_type to "reference" to look up by your own reference_customer_id. Returns name, email, and tax-exempt status. Numeral: GET /tax/customers/{customer_id}.

customer_id.description: The customer id — a Numeral id (cus_...) by default, or your reference id when id_type="reference".

id_type.description: Which id space `customer_id` is in (default: numeral).

tools.name: numeral_create_transaction
tools.title: Create transaction
tools.description: RECORDS a completed sale as a transaction — this WRITES a live tax/compliance record used for filings. Supply the `calculation_id` returned by numeral_calculate_tax and your `reference_order_id`. Numeral: POST /tax/transactions.

calculation_id.description: The calculation id returned by numeral_calculate_tax.

reference_order_id.description: Your order id for this sale (used for record keeping / dedupe).

transaction_processed_at.description: Unix timestamp (SECONDS) the sale was processed. Defaults to now if omitted.

tools.name: numeral_create_refund
tools.title: Create refund
tools.description: RECORDS a refund against a transaction — this WRITES a live tax/compliance record (adjusts tax owed). Use type="full" to refund the whole transaction, or type="partial" with line_items (each keyed by reference_product_id) for a partial refund. Numeral: POST /tax/refunds.

type.description: "full" refunds the whole transaction; "partial" requires line_items.

refund_processed_at.description: Unix timestamp (SECONDS) the refund was made. Defaults to now if omitted.

line_items.description: Required for type="partial": the line items to refund.

reference_product_id.description: Product id to apply the refund against (matches the original transaction line item).

sales_amount_refunded.description: Sale amount refunded for this line, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).

tools.name: numeral_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: CREATES (or upserts) a product with its tax category — this WRITES to your Numeral product catalog, which drives future tax calculations. Numeral: POST /tax/products.

reference_product_id.description: Your product id (used to reference this product in calculations).

product_category.description: A tax category from Numeral's taxonomy, e.g. "GENERAL_MERCHANDISE", "SAAS_GENERAL".

tools.name: numeral_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: CREATES a customer record — this WRITES to your Numeral customer list (used for order tracking and tax exemptions). Numeral: POST /tax/customers.

is_tax_exempt.description: Whether this customer is tax exempt.

reference_customer_id.description: Your own id for this customer (for reference-based lookups).
